text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (Secondary to substance-induced psychosis or primary psychotic disorder).

The patient reports an 8-month history of believing he can no longer telepathically communicate with animals, which he attributes to weather conditions, and has self-medicated with Peruvian herbs. Given the chronic nature of these fixed false beliefs and the somatic focus on "failing health," I need to rule out organic causes and substance intoxication/withdrawal.
